primary.usage: Logo background, header bar, primary buttons, main text, active tab fills

secondary.usage: Page background, logo letterforms (GJ monogram), button text on dark, card backgrounds

accent_red.usage: Discount/sale percentage badges, price reduction indicators, border accents on sale items

background_light.usage: Newsletter section background, subtle section separators

background_mid.usage: Secondary section backgrounds, input field backgrounds

text_secondary.usage: Secondary body text, product descriptions, muted labels

text_muted.usage: Placeholder text, disabled states, tertiary copy

text_vendor.usage: Vendor names, current prices, secondary UI elements

primary.note: Custom web font loaded via @font-face, NOT Google Fonts

weights_used.note: Remarkably uniform weight usage. No bold headings found - the brand relies on size contrast rather than weight contrast

logo.description: Square black container with white 'GJ' monogram in a clean geometric sans-serif. The letters are custom-drawn, slightly stylized. Rendered as inline SVG with viewBox '0 0 100 100'. Black fill path forms the square, white fill-rule 'evenodd' paths form the G and J letterforms.
variants: Standard: black square with white GJ (used on white backgrounds)
Transparent/inverted: white GJ on transparent (used over hero imagery/dark backgrounds)
logo.history: Pre-2011: italic blue 'Gloria Jeans' wordmark with oversized G and J, horizontal bar underneath. 2011-2013: white on dark blue background. 2013-2022: red square emblem with white GJ + blue 'Gloria Jeans' wordmark. 2022-present: minimalist black/gray square with white GJ only, no wordmark.

tone.language_style: Short, descriptive product copy. Adjective-rich, tactile descriptions (textures, fits, materials). No exclamation-heavy hype. Straightforward and practical.
tone.brand_tagline: Clothing for real life (Одежда для реальной жизни)
tone.brand_values: Love yourself. Be who you want. Be free. Do what you like.
copy_examples: Актуальные модели для деловых и кежуал-образов, которые подчеркнут настроение (Relevant models for business and casual looks that highlight your mood)
Непринуждённые силуэты и базовые модели, которые впишутся в его ритм (Relaxed silhouettes and basic models that fit his rhythm)
Узнавайте раньше всех о трендах, акциях и скидках (Be the first to learn about trends, promotions, and discounts)

visual_style.aesthetic: Modern minimalist with high-contrast monochrome foundation. Clean, editorial feel. Black-and-white palette dominates with color used only for functional UI signals (sale badges, new-arrival tags).
visual_style.photography: Lifestyle-editorial. Models in natural/outdoor settings (roads at night, beaches, urban environments). Warm, slightly desaturated tones. Mix of studio product shots (neutral gray/white backgrounds) and atmospheric campaign imagery. Youth-oriented energy without being overtly streetwear.
visual_style.layout: Full-bleed hero banners with image carousels. 4-column product grids. Generous whitespace between sections. Rounded pill buttons (border-radius: 12px) for CTAs. Outlined/ghost-style buttons ('Смотреть' / View) over imagery.

ui_patterns.buttons_primary: Black fill, white text, rounded corners
ui_patterns.buttons_secondary: White/transparent border, white text (on dark) or black text (on light), rounded corners (12px radius)
ui_patterns.product_cards: Clean white background, minimal borders, category pill tags with border (outlined style)
ui_patterns.navigation: Horizontal top nav, all-caps for SALE section only, Pragmatica-Book 17px
ui_patterns.sticky_toolbar: Floating white pill in bottom-right with search, account, and cart icons

visual_style.framework: Angular (custom web components: gj-logo, gj-link, svg-icon). Swiper.js for carousels. Mindbox/PopMechanic for personalization widgets.

awards: Narodnaya Marka (People's Brand) #1 in Russia 2024 in 'Clothing retail chain' category
